title: Fixed Twin Arm Yoke Stage Lamp
description: One newly authored complete fixed stage-lamp appearance. A whole low chamfered ground base carries a stepped vertical pan seat and spindle, supporting one continuous thick U-shaped yoke with a genuine open middle. Two opposed horizontal axles and outer caps support a separate deep cylindrical lamp housing in a single inclined pose. The housing has a real thick annular front opening, a deeply recessed opaque optic, a closed rear cap and three exterior rings. This is not the old one-sided task-lamp stem and downward shade, or the raised mirror head and flat stage of a classroom projector; every whole numeric component is newly authored. Three opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up and full horizontally centred ground datum. One complete prop and zero scenes. Unlit static game-art exterior only: no beam, emission, transparent optical simulation, pan/tilt movement or clearance guarantee, light output, focusing, electronics, cooling, electrical operation, mounting, manufacture or safety claim.
